findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Inspector observed the ice machine to be soiled on the interior baffles. Ensure the ice machine is cleaned and sanitized frequently to prevent an accumulation of soil. A follow-up will be conducted on 06/22/2026 to ensure the ice machine has been properly cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed milkshake machine to be soiled with old food matter. PIC informed that a shake was just made. The current process for the milkshake machine is to clean the mixer attachment with clean water between uses, and clean/sanitize at the end of each day. Since the ice cream milk contacting the mixer attachment is a time/temperature for safety (TCS) food, the mixer attachment needs to be sanitized at minimum every four hours. Water is not an adequate form of sanitization. The mixer attachment needs to be submerged in sanitizer and air-dried to properly sanitize. PIC properly sanitized mixer attachment during the inspection. Ensure staff are sanitizing the attachment at least every four hours during use.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.11(C) Equipment Food-Contact Surfaces and Utensils. (C) Except as specified in (D) of this section, if used with TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD, EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be cleaned throughout the day at least every 4 hours.
